title: Fixed Return Frame Cantilever Dining Chair
description: One newly authored complete static dining chair with two continuous bent C-profile flat-metal side members. Each grounded rear return runs forward along the floor, rises only at the front and turns rearward into the free seat-bearing rail; the whole rear under-seat region has no rear upright or crossed scissor member. One rear ground cross-tie joins the returns. Four small fixed mounts carry one continuous thick seat-and-reclined-back shell. This is not the old four-legged slatted dining chair, the fully closed sled-side observing chair or crossed-frame canvas camping chair with a leg removed. All full profiles and numeric geometry are new. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, native metres and whole XY-centred ground origin, one whole prop and no scenes or extra poses. Static visual furniture only: no spring flex, working cantilever elasticity, ergonomic or human fit, material fabrication, load, stability, comfort or safety certification.
